dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity markings with soft, diffused outer margins that transition from a lighter interior to a darker exterior, distributed across the central and posterior lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous, solid high-intensity light clusters concentrated along the lower lateral boundary and in the anterior-dorsal region, appearing as discrete spots without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary scalene triangle formed by the centroids of three prominent mid-body annuli, with a secondary linear alignment of centroids observed along the lower posterior flank.
